auditSummary: Balance sheet source coverage analysis distinguishing SOURCE_MISSING (quarterly NSE XBRL archive) from WEALTHOS_MISSING (global WealthOS availability).

total_assets.missingReason: SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly NSE XBRL (Indian MCA/SEBI Ind AS quarterly reporting standard mandates P&L and Cash Flow statements, but only mandates full Balance Sheet in Annual Filings).

total_liabilities.missingReason: SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly NSE XBRL (Mandated only in Annual Filings under SEBI LODR).

borrowings_debt.periodCoverage: QUARTERLY (Cash Flow debt financing lines + D/E ratio) / ANNUAL (net_debt)
borrowings_debt.companyCoverage: 3,019 companies in FERE; 3,547 companies in Trendlyne
borrowings_debt.missingReason: Gross debt stock is SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly XBRL balance sheets, but debt financing flows (debt_raised, debt_repaid) and leverage ratios (debt_to_equity) are available quarterly in FERE.

cash_and_cash_equivalents.missingReason: Quarterly balance sheet cash stock is SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly XBRL; net change in cash flows is captured via CFO+CFI+CFF.

trade_receivables.missingReason: SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly NSE XBRL; mandated only in full annual audited financial statements.

inventory.missingReason: Balance sheet inventory stock is SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly filings, but P&L inventory change (inventory_change) is fully available quarterly across 24,584 records.

equity_capital.missingReason: NOT_MISSING. Fully available quarterly across 49,880 records in FERE_NSE_XBRL.

working_capital_items.missingReason: Balance sheet stock levels are SOURCE_MISSING in quarterly XBRL, while inventory change and working-capital adjustments to CFO are captured in quarterly cash flows.
